title: The Distinct sound in the night
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：distinct　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 distinct 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the craftsman wrote of ① a distinct sound in the night in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② more distinct than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the distinct ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most distinct sound in the night anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1980 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too distinct to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the distinct ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a distinct smell of the herbs, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as distinct as the smell of the herbs they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was distinct or not, and he said so.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something distinct, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite distinct; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the distinct ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996, twice over, she wrote of another distinct sound in the night in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more distinct than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most distinct smell of the herbs in the whole workshop, she said in 1998, was the one she could never quite name; the distinct ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 截然不同（前置定语 a distinct sound in the night：1986 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件截然不同的声响）
B. adj. 截然不同／清晰（比较级 more distinct than：文中两处，一处比夜里的声响，一处比预想）
C. adj. 截然不同／清晰（最高级 the most distinct：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 截然不同（表语 too distinct to do：母亲觉得它太截然不同，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 清晰（前置定语 a distinct smell of the herbs：叔叔把整件事称作一桩清晰的气味）
F. adj. 清晰（同级比较 as distinct as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩草药的气味相比）
G. adj. 清晰（后置定语 something distinct：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 清晰（受程度副词修饰 quite distinct：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a distinct sound in the night
the most distinct sound in the night anybody
a distinct smell of the herbs
The most distinct smell of the herbs in

answers.why: distinct 意为“截然不同”，1986 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件截然不同的声响”，此处作前置定语 a distinct sound in the night。
distinct 意为“截然不同”，此处用比较级 more distinct than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
distinct 意为“截然不同”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说它是工坊里最截然不同的一件，故用最高级 the most distinct sound in the night。
distinct 意为“截然不同”，母亲认为这件东西“太截然不同了，谁也用不上”，too distinct to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
distinct 意为“清晰”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩清晰的气味”，此处作前置定语 a distinct smell of the herbs。
distinct 意为“清晰”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩草药的气味一样清晰”，同级比较用 as distinct as。
distinct 意为“清晰”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“清晰的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something distinct。
distinct 意为“清晰”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当清晰”，quite 修饰原级 distinct。
distinct 意为“清晰”，1996 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要清晰”，故用比较级 more distinct than。
distinct 意为“清晰”，母亲 1998 年说的是“整个工坊里最清晰的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most distinct smell of the herbs。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件截然不同的声响。（a distinct sound in the night）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更截然不同。（more distinct than …）
母亲觉得它太截然不同，谁也用不上。（too distinct to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩清晰的气味。（a distinct smell of the herbs）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩草药的气味一样清晰。（as distinct as …）
到了 1993 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件清晰的东西。（something distinct）
answers: In 1986 the craftsman wrote of a distinct sound in the night in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more distinct than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too distinct to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a distinct smell of the herbs.
He said nobody would call it as distinct as the smell of the herbs they had once had.
By 1993 the ledger asked for nothing but something distinct.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 distinct 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the craftsman wrote of a distinct sound in the night in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most distinct sound in the night in the workshop, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too distinct to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a distinct smell of the herbs, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite distinct, and everybody laughed.
The distinct ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
